prompt_text: What is a good martial arts school for kids in St. Peters MO?
answer_verbatim:
A good place to start is **All Star Karate**, at **235 Jungermann Road, Suite 101**. It teaches Isshinryu karate and has kids’ classes; local parent feedback highlights a welcoming, structured environment and says the school offers an introductory program. [Website](https://allstarkarate.com/)

If you’re open to other styles, **World Martial Arts Academy** (1057 Cave Springs Blvd.) offers age-grouped classes for preschoolers and kids, with a **14-day trial listed for $49**. [Website](https://blackbeltstl.com/)

For a grappling-focused option, **Revive Brazilian Jiu Jitsu** (1278 Jungermann Road) lists kids’ BJJ, no-gi, kickboxing, and judo classes. [Website](https://www.revivebjj.com/)

I’d visit or try a class at two schools before committing. Watch how instructors handle beginners, whether kids are engaged and treated respectfully, and ask about total costs and contract terms.
